name: Open Research Europe platform expansion
organization: European Commission, DFG and participating funders
description: The Commission's collectively financed, fee-free open publishing platform and how eligibility expands beyond EU-project beneficiaries to national participation. CERN operates the service with a Publish-Review-Curate model.

milestones.label: DFG announces Open Research Europe scientific advisory board (implementation update)
